name: Planet Netcomm
summary: Sydney ISP (pnc.com.au, AS7694; originally Penrith NetCom — Penrith local dialup ~1996; company renamed Planet Netcom Pty Ltd); AusBone Sydney (SIX) participant with a 2M DDS link; peering contact Luke McKinnon. Acquired by Datafast Telecommunications Ltd Feb 2004 (PENRITH NETCOM PTY LTD (NOW PLANET NETCOM PTY. LIMITED), ACN 066 981 235).

events.details: Penrith NetCom, local Penrith dialup (pnc.com.au) from ~1996; the company (ACN 066 981 235) renamed Planet Netcom Pty Ltd by Jan 1997 (earliest Planet Netcomm capture 4 Jan 1997).
Acquired by Datafast Telecommunications Ltd — Datafast announced acquisition; finalised by end Mar 2004.
